hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*|*"git push"*) if [ "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "main" ]; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: no direct commits or pushes to main. Per AGENTS.md, work on a feature branch and let the Lead integrate."}}'; fi ;; esac

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv run ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
